metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

transfer.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. Every bilinear contributor must be within 20 m of the closest RMOC source point; the same point must be visible in the full RMOC mesh.

metadata.label: OSIRIS mosaic
metadata.coverage: Eight OSIRIS orange-filter photographs from August 2014 and October–November 2015. Unsupported surface patches retain the grid.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.notes: Nucleus shape measured by Rosetta and simplified for display. The gray surface is a model material.

controls.label: OSIRIS mosaic
controls.notes: Eight Rosetta photographs show cliffs, pits and smoother plains across both hemispheres. Grid marks gaps in the photography; original shadows and some seams remain.

controls.label: Albedo
controls.notes: How strongly surface grains scatter green light. Higher values mean more scattering. Turn Shadows off to read the color scale.

controls.label: Spectral slope
controls.notes: How much reflectance rises from green to red light. Higher values mean a redder spectrum. Turn Shadows off to read the color scale.

controls.label: 3.2 µm absorption
controls.notes: Strength of the broad 3.2 µm absorption band. This measurement alone cannot tell us how much organic material is present. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.

controls.label: Modeled ice
controls.notes: Estimated ice seen in reflected light, not the ice stored inside the comet. A value of 0% means the model fitted no ice. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.

controls.label: Regions
controls.notes: Color separates the 26 named regions used to describe the comet’s terrain. These are geographical divisions, not different minerals. Grid marks places where the source maps could not be matched reliably to this shape.

controls.label: Geology
controls.notes: Fractures, cliffs, terraces and small features mapped from Rosetta images. Lines and dots are map symbols, not their true widths or sizes. Grid marks areas outside the study or without a reliable shape match.
